faq.question: Q1. What is HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare Limited has issued an advertisement numbered HLL/BGM/HR/KFB/08/2026 to recruit 5 candidates for Senior Production Assistant (Pharma), Production Assistant, and Lab Analyst (Microbiologist) posts on a fixed term contract basis at its Kanagala factory.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available, which include 2 for Senior Production Assistant (Pharma), 2 for Production Assistant, and 1 for Lab Analyst (Microbiologist).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to receive filled applications is 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Production Assistant (Pharma)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy or B.Sc along with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the production department of a pharmaceutical plant or similar industry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for HLL vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their resume and application in the format downloaded from the official website along with supporting documents to the General Manager (Operations) & Unit Chief at HLL Lifecare Limited, Kanagala via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a written test, skill test, or interview as applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The approximate gross monthly salary is Rs. 19,770/- for Senior Production Assistant (Pharma) and Lab Analyst (Microbiologist), and Rs. 17,793/- for Production Assistant.

faq.question: Q10. Who needs to avoid applying again?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already applied against Advertisement No. HLL/BGM/HR/KFB/05/2026 dated 12-08-2026 or Advertisement No. HLL/BGM/HR/KFB/06/2026 dated 09-09-2026 need not apply again.
